blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Gilas Pilipinas Women’s Youth team finished in sixth place in the Fiba U18 Women’s Asia Cup 2026 and missed out on a spot in next year’s Fiba U19 Women’s Basketball World Cup. Gilas girls lost to Chinese Taipei, 86-55, on Friday in the fifth-place classification match, which dangled the last Asian berth to the World Cup. They crashed out of semifinal contention after a 112-49 setback to China on Thursday.
